definitions.explanation: Reacting more strongly than normal to stimuli, whether physical (allergens, chemicals) or emotional (criticism, noise). Used in both medical and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過敏|かびん}になっている。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{過敏|かびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧。

⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過敏|かびん}になって⟦{何|なに}もかも→何もかも：26777_nanimokamo⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: During pollen season my nose becomes hypersensitive and every smell bothers me.

notes:
USAGE:
{過敏|かびん} can describe both physical sensitivity (allergies, skin conditions) and emotional/psychological sensitivity (overreacting to criticism or stimuli).

COMPOUNDS:
- {過敏症|かびんしょう} (hypersensitivity; allergy)
- {過敏性腸症候群|かびんせいちょうしょうこうぐん} (irritable bowel syndrome / IBS)
- {化学物質過敏症|かがくぶっしつかびんしょう} (chemical sensitivity)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過敏|かびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧ (to react oversensitively)
- {過敏|かびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become hypersensitive)
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{過敏|かびん} (nervous hypersensitivity)
